people.name: Cilicia
people.line: Province in Asia Minor; Paul's birthplace and ministry area

people.name: Lycia
people.line: A region on the southwest coast of Asia Minor

people.name: Myra
people.line: A city in Lycia where Paul's ship stopped

people.name: Pamphylia
people.line: A Roman province in Asia Minor

translations.web: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
translations.bsb: And when we had sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra in Lycia.
translations.kjv: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
translations.asv: And when we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
